zh.title: 发布说明
items: **0.1.0-rc.32** 保留长会话输入修复、独立第四栏和回复引用，加入工作现场面板，并整合任务停止、资源移交和原目标持续跟进。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

zh.title: 新功能与优化
items: 工作现场面板集中显示任务、子 Agent 进度、当前注意力及产出资料；宽屏可并排查看，窄屏按需展开。开合与切换保留主对话、草稿和原任务入口，读取失败可以重试。
网页、文件、变更和只读子 Agent 会话继续在独立第四栏打开，与机器人资料和设置分开。文件阅读区分层显示名称、位置和正文／源码／Diff，历史片段与当前文件分别标明。
智能输入建议设置收敛为一个总开关和专用模型选择；默认开启，未选择建议模型时不发请求。模型选择旁说明当前对话和未发送草稿会交给该模型。建议只在明确采纳后进入草稿，不会自动发送。
Bot、经典对话、Quick Chat 和设置共用模型选择器，保留各入口的模型范围与保存失败恢复。
调查阶段的签收不再代替整个目标完成；主 Bot 根据剩余要求继续协调，根目标关闭需要当前核验、实际交付和没有未决责任。局部交付故障与渠道故障分别处理。

zh.title: 修复
items: 保留逐键草稿更新隔离和轻量身份检查，保存草稿不再投影整份机器人历史；长会话输入修复已由用户在隔离源码窗口试用确认。
取消、接管、恢复和资源交接共用停止屏障；恢复等待期间释放协调写入锁，失败的替换任务也结清已持有资源。历史未知结果继续保护其实际范围，不盲目重放。
修复旧任务缺少工作标识时的 SQLite 查询异常，以及联合数据格式先于设备资源账本启用导致首次任务被阻断的问题。已启用资源契约的账本丢失时仍保留保护。
缩窄窗口时立即限制工作面板的动画留位，避免对话被短暂压窄而丢失阅读位置和划词引用。
更新双语 README、使用文档、落地页和网站更新日志。

zh.title: 升级与范围
items: **本版引入联合协调格式 9。** 升级前备份完整数据目录，Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway 使用匹配版本。旧程序不能接管格式 9 的活跃数据；降级需要恢复升级前的完整备份，不能删除字段或账本强行继续。
未知操作、外部异步效果和未受管句柄不因取消、目标关闭或发版而变成已确认。模型直接声明的资源等待入口仍未开放；既有排队任务继续沿宿主资源事实恢复。
发布操作不安装或重启当前应用。源码 Electron 与受控模型回归不能代替真实供应商质量、全部系统输入法与读屏、各平台安装交互或长期使用验证。

en.title: Release notes
items: **0.1.0-rc.32** retains the long-conversation typing fix, independent fourth pane and reply quoting, adds a work panel, and integrates stopping, resource handoff and continued ownership of the original goal. Stable remains 0.0.18.

en.title: What's new and improvements
items: The work panel brings tasks, child Agent progress, current attention and saved materials together. It sits beside wide conversations and opens on demand in narrow layouts, preserving the conversation, draft and original task destinations. Failed reads can be retried.

Web pages, files, diffs and read-only child conversations remain in a fourth pane separate from Bot details and settings. Document names, locations and body/source/diff controls have clearer hierarchy; saved historical snippets stay distinct from current files.

Smart input suggestions use one switch and a dedicated model picker. The switch defaults on, but requests require a selected suggestion model. Adjacent disclosure explains that the current conversation and unsent draft go to that model. Suggestions enter the draft only when accepted and never send automatically.
Bot, classic chat, Quick Chat and settings share a model picker while preserving each entry point's model scope and save-failure recovery.

Accepting an investigation stage does not complete the whole goal. The main Bot coordinates remaining requirements; root closure requires current verification, actual delivery and no outstanding obligations. Work-local delivery failures and provider faults are isolated.

en.title: Fixes
items: Retain isolated draft updates and lightweight identity checks instead of projecting full Bot history on each save. The user confirmed smooth long-conversation typing in an isolated source window.

Cancellation, takeover, resume and resource handoff share a stop barrier. Resume waits release the coordination writer, and failed replacement tasks settle held resources. Unknown historical outcomes retain protection of their actual scope without blind replay.

Fix SQLite queries for legacy tasks without work IDs and initialize the device resource ledger before enabling the combined format. Loss of a ledger under an active resource contract still keeps admission protected.
Bound the work panel's animated reservation immediately when the window narrows, preserving reading position and selection quoting through responsive changes.
Update bilingual READMEs, usage documentation, the landing page and website changelog.

en.title: Upgrade and scope
items: **This release introduces combined coordination format 9.** Back up the complete data directory and use matching Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway versions. Older executors cannot take over active format-9 data. Downgrading requires the complete pre-upgrade backup; deleting fields or the ledger is not a recovery path.

Unknown operations, external asynchronous effects and unmanaged handles do not become confirmed because of cancellation, goal closure or this release. Model-declared resource waiting remains unavailable; existing queued tasks recover through host resource facts.

Publishing does not install or restart the current app. Source Electron and controlled-model regression do not replace real-provider quality, full OS IME and screen-reader coverage, platform installation interaction or long-duration acceptance.
